name: 1st Degree: What a Lovely Summer
source:
Play as Rei and enjoy four different dates with the four routes from the main game! Each date has a different background and its own CG! But be careful, choose the wrong answers and you might just end up pissing everyone off. 
[From [url=https://parival.itch.io/1st-degree-what-a-lovely-summer]official game page[/url]]
translation:
扮演Rei，与本篇四条路线的恋爱对象分别享受四场不同的约会！每场约会都有不同的背景和专属CG！不过请小心，选错回答，可就会把大家全都惹毛。
[摘自[url=https://parival.itch.io/1st-degree-what-a-lovely-summer]游戏官方页面[/url]]
